Playstation 5 - Witness Play Unleashed

With the PlayStation®5 Pro console, the world’s greatest game creators can enhance their games with incredible features like advanced ray tracing, super sharp image clarity for your 4K TV, and high frame rate gameplay.* That means you get to play PS5® games with the most impressive visuals ever possible on a PlayStation® console, and with 2TB of SSD storage included, your favorite games will be ready and waiting for you to jump right in for your next awesome adventure.

PS5® Pro is an all-digital console with no disc drive. Sign into your account for PlayStation™Network and go to PlayStation™Store to buy and download games. PS5™ - PLAY HAS NO LIMITS

The PS5™ console unleashes new gaming possibilities that you never anticipated.  

Experience lightning-fast loading with an ultra-high-speed SSD, deeper immersion with support for haptic feedback, adaptive triggers and 3D Audio, and an all-new generation of incredible PlayStation® games. 

Lightning Speed 

Harness the power of a custom CPU, GPU and SSD with Integrated I/O that rewrite the rules of what a PlayStation® console can do. 

Stunning Games 

Marvel at incredible graphics and experience new PS5™ features. 

Breathtaking Immersion 

Discover a deeper gaming experience with support for haptic feedback, adaptive triggers, and 3D Audio technology. 

Heighten Your Senses™

Discover a deeper, highly immersive gaming experience that brings the action to life in the palms of your hands. The DualSense™ wireless controller offers immersive haptic feedback, dynamic adaptive triggers and a built-in microphone, all integrated into an iconic comfortable design. 

How Games Were Made to Sound™

Enjoy a seamless, wireless experience with a headset fine-tuned for 3D Audio on PS5™ consoles2. The PULSE 3D™ wireless headset features a refined design with dual noise-cancelling microphones, built-in rechargeable battery, and an array of easy-access controls. 

Personalize your gameplay sharing 

Featuring dual lenses for 1080p capture and a built-in stand, the HD camera works seamlessly with the PS5™ background removal tools to put you in the spotlight. Quickly create a recording or a broadcast of yourself and your gameplay, with your DualSense™ wireless controller’s create button3. 

Click. Charge. Play. 

Charge up to two DualSense™ wireless controllers at the same time and dock them quickly and easily with the charging station’s click-in design. Your controllers charge as quickly as when connected to your PS5™ console – so you can free up USB ports without sacrificing performance. 

Entertainment at the push of a button 

Conveniently navigate entertainment3 on your PlayStation®5 console with an intuitive layout featuring media controls. Simplify your set-up with the ability to power on your PS5™ console directly and adjust the volume and power settings of compatible TVs4.  

PlayStation 5 Will Change the Way You Play

Sony’s PlayStation 5 has exploded onto the scene, and it’s nothing short of a gaming revolution! Released in late 2020, the PS5 is built to wow with mind-blowing performance, lightning-fast speed, and jaw-dropping visuals. 

Thanks to its ultra-high-speed SSD, custom GPU, and CPU, this console takes gaming to another level. And let’s not forget those game-changing features like adaptive triggers, haptic feedback, and 3D Audio. This next-gen powerhouse is truly redefining what gaming can be.

Why Upgrade to PS5?

If you haven’t made the jump to the PlayStation 5 yet, here’s why upgrading is an absolute no-brainer:

  • Lightning-Fast Load Times: The PS5’s 825GB SSD delivers near-instant load times, letting you jump into your games without the wait.
  • Haptic Feedback & Adaptive Triggers: The DualSense wireless controller lets you feel the action—whether it’s the tension of a bowstring or the impact of a crash.
  • 3D Audio: With Tempest 3D AudioTech, the sound surrounds you, making every footstep, explosion, and whisper feel incredibly real.
  • Eye-popping 4K Visuals & Ray Tracing: Experience lifelike lighting, shadows, and razor-sharp details, making games look more cinematic than ever.
  • 120 FPS for Seamless Gameplay: Ultra-smooth, lag-free gameplay makes every move feel precise, giving you the edge in fast-paced games. Game Boost also enhances older games for an even smoother experience.

A Masterpiece in Design

Sleek, modern, and iconic—the PlayStation 5 is a true visual stunner. Taking its cues from the PS4 but ramping it up, this gaming console features a minimalist black-and-white design with smooth wings that scream futuristic. Whether you set it up vertically or horizontally, it fits right in with any gaming setup. And with that slim form factor, it’s a statement piece for gamers everywhere.

Specs That Pack a Punch!

Whether it’s rendering stunning 4K visuals with ray tracing or providing 3D Audio immersion, the PS5 is a true next-gen beast. Get ready for a next-gen gaming experience with jaw-dropping specs like:

  • 825GB SSD for near-instant loading
  • Custom AMD Ryzen CPU & RDNA 2 GPU
  • 3D Audio technology for mind-blowing immersion
  • DualSense™ controller with haptic feedback and dynamic adaptive triggers

Games That Are Beyond Epic

Sony has pulled out all the stops to give you the most responsive, fluid, and immersive gaming experience. PS5 games are built with cutting-edge tech that will make you feel the difference. From ultra HD graphics to HDR-powered vibrant colours, you’ll be blown away by the sharpness and clarity. And with a higher, more stable frame rate, your gaming experience is silky-smooth, no matter how intense the action gets.

The best part? JB’s got all the hottest PS5 titles in Australia, like Star Wars Outlaws, Final Fantasy, Marvel’s Spider-Man 2, Horizon Forbidden West, Gran Turismo 7, Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart, Astro Bot and more!

Play Your Favourites, and Then Some with Backward Compatibility

Worried about your PS4 library? Fear not! PS5 is backward-compatible, so you can still enjoy your favourite PlayStation 4 games. Some even get the remastered treatment—like The Last of Us—with upgraded visuals and performance. Plus, many titles are optimised for the PS5 Pro, delivering enhanced upscaling and smoother gameplay for an even more impressive experience.

Don’t miss out on PlayStation Plus either—it gives you access to exclusive offers, online multiplayer, and free video games every month. You can also share the fun with friends and family by gifting them PlayStation gift cards, perfect for downloading games, in-game content, and more.

PS5 Slim vs. PS5 Pro – Which Console is Right for You?

Sony’s PlayStation lineup just got even more exciting with the Playstation 5 Slim and PlayStation 5 Pro, two PlayStation 5 consoles that cater to different types of gamers - and JB’s got them all! If you’re not sure which PS5 console is right for you, here’s a quick breakdown:

PS5 Slim

  • Compact design: Smaller and lighter than the original PS5, perfect for tight spaces.
  • Same performance: Keeps the same 825GB SSD, AMD Ryzen Zen 2 CPU, and RDNA 2 GPU for speedy load times and great graphics.
  • Affordable: Ideal if you want next-gen gaming at a lower price.

PS5 Pro

  • Boosted performance: Equipped with a custom RDNA 3 GPU, offering smoother 4K at 120 FPS gameplay and advanced ray tracing for more realistic visuals.
  • Higher memory: With 16GB GDDR6 RAM, expect faster speeds and more detailed textures.
  • 8K support: Perfect for those with top-tier displays looking for ultra-high-resolution gaming.

PS5 Digital Edition – Go All-Digital!

Ready to embrace the future of gaming? The PS5 Digital Edition gives you all the same incredible performance as the PS5 Slim but without the disc drive.

Perfect for gamers who live for digital downloads, the Digital Edition is fast, sleek, and always ready. Just sign in to your PlayStation Network account, download games straight from the PlayStation Store, and get right to playing. With lightning-fast speeds and integrated I/O, this version is built for those who want instant access to their favourite titles.
